original_test_intent: Verify both front USB2 connectors sustain 12-hour operation at 0C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails without data, reconnect, controller or platform errors.
original_method: Map slots1-2 to tools/cables and hub/controller; preserve baseline; control humidity/dew point, cold-soak and ramp to measured -5% rails; run approved simultaneous or sequential SST profile for 12 hours with per-port integrity, enumeration, resets/retries and events; abort on limits, warm safely and restore nominal state.
manual_activity: Operator connects both tools, controls dry chamber/negative rails, supervises stress and warms/restores safely.
required_inputs: Simultaneous/sequential SST profile and integrity volume
safety_requirements: Measure rails independently and prevent undershoot
Abort on moisture, common hub reset, data mismatch or electrical/thermal fault
Warm above dew point before opening chamber
agent_execution_scope: Must not manipulate connectors/chamber/rails or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Review both connectors and determine verdict
